description: Validator with 6 rules — high chance a single agent drops one.

input.message:
Write a Python function `is_valid_username(name)` returning True/False. ALL rules must be implemented:
1. Length must be between 3 and 16 characters inclusive.
2. Only lowercase letters, digits and underscore allowed.
3. Must NOT start with a digit.
4. Must NOT contain two consecutive underscores.
5. Must return False (not raise) for a non-string input.
6. Include a docstring.
Output one Python code block.
